title: tc-conversation-annotation
description: A conversation transcript to annotate: label spans, redact, rate turns, correct answers and send the example on.

heading.description: The heading, and the transcript's accessible name

description.description: A quieter line under the heading – where the conversation came from

labels.description: The label set; the first nine get the shortcut keys 1–9

value.description: Spans, ratings and corrections. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

ratingLevels.description: The rating scale for a turn, lowest first

rateRoles.description: The roles whose turns can be rated

correctRoles.description: The roles whose turns can be corrected

roleLabels.description: Display names per role; an unknown role shows as written

sending.description: The app is sending the example: the button shows it's busy

sent.description: The app has stored the example: the button reads "Sent to dataset" until the value changes

name.description: Submitted with the form: the value as JSON

disabled.description: Turns every control off and leaves the value out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

author.description: Who wrote it, shown after the role – "Dana · Support"

text.description: The exact text; span offsets index into it

label.description: "Unsupported" – on the legend button and after each mark

tone.description: The colour of its marks; defaults by position

description.description: What it means, in a line – the legend button's tooltip

AnnotationTone.description: One of the tone token families: --tc-tone-<tone>-bg / -fg / -solid

quote.description: The text between start and end when it was made – a span whose text changed is flagged

label.description: The label's id; "" for a redaction

redacted.description: Redacted: shown as a bar, blanked out in the export

AnnotationSpan.description: A labelled or redacted span. Offsets are UTF-16 indices into the message text

label.description: A word for the level – "Good"; read after the number
